name: ATR
description: This keyword gives the ATR value in series of the selected Instrument. This keyword is to be used in the Position keyword
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword gives the ATR value in series of the selected Instrument. This keyword is to be used in the Position keyword

![Example](./images/img-1632219122.png)

The above condition will output the ATR period 14 of NIFTY 50 futures in 15min timeframe

Average true range (ATR) is a volatility indicator that shows how much an asset moves, on average, during a given time frame.

Read more about ATR here - https://www.investopedia.com/articles/technical/02/092402.asp
